question: In which of the following places were the fire altars of Harappan culture found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lothal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fire altars of Harappan culture were found in the Lothal.**
 
• Fire altars are** pits meant for religious rites **involving sacrifices to fire.
 
• These were a hallmark of Aryan religious beliefs.
 
• Shreds of evidence of fire altars are found in Lothal and Kalibangan towards the late Harappan phase, showing the presence of immigrants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
